brief_summary: Two-column do/don't diagram. Left column shows the two conditions the May 2026 decline piece named as necessary to reverse Alice's fade — a sub-$200 pre-built hot-swap/wireless Alice, and a split-Alice hybrid with adjustable splay angle — both marked NOT SHIPPED in dashed caution-red outline. Right column shows what actually happened instead across W36 through W42: Keychron's B40/B39 launch, buying-guide reframing, and scattered Epomaker/Qwertykeys boutique activity, all in filled coral boxes.
